subject.title: fix: Windows /restart falls back to in-process restart without changing PID

question: Should env-less Windows gateways with an installed Scheduled Task be treated as supervised by probing `schtasks`, and which task-name contract should that probe follow?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but changing restart fallback behavior can make a gateway exit for the wrong task if profile/custom task names are not aligned with the handoff path.

options.title: Fix exact task detection in the linked PR
options.body: Have the candidate PR query the same default/profile/custom Scheduled Task name that `triggerOpenClawRestart()` will run, then require Windows PID or uptime proof before merge.

options.title: Keep current in-process fallback
options.body: Reject the schtasks probe direction and document that manually started Windows gateways without service markers use in-process restart unless launched through the Scheduled Task.

options.title: Accept default-task-only probing
options.body: Allow the candidate PR to probe only `OpenClaw Gateway`, accepting false negatives or false positives for profiled/custom task setups as owned risk.

recommendation.title: Fix exact task detection in the linked PR
recommendation.body: Have the candidate PR query the same default/profile/custom Scheduled Task name that `triggerOpenClawRestart()` will run, then require Windows PID or uptime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the Windows Scheduled Task restart path that the decision would extend.
